description: Guard (016 T014m). A tag line opens a script element after a div, so the browser stays in the script past the blank line CommonMark ends the div block at, and the hidden rule's marker is inside it. The digest on disk carries only the visible rule, so the check must say OK; harvesting the hidden marker would call this correct digest stale. A tag line that opens a raw-text element later on the line takes that element's end; without that, the marker is harvested. Since 016 phase 2 (plan D8 and D11 as amended during phase 2) the marker passed over inside the comment is also reported by DIGEST-020, so the run fails naming its line; a mutation that harvests it drops that report and reads the digest stale.
